1080x1080.notes: Square. The one shape that runs everywhere on Meta -- feed post, feed ad, and the safe fallback in a carousel.
1080x1080._textCoverageSource: Meta's 20% text guideline. It stopped being a rejection rule in September 2020 and is now a delivery signal: a text-heavy image is served less, not refused. Checked 2026-08-28.
